description:
Amid relentless debt collection and the grueling daily grind of delivery work, in a land where gratitude has vanished, rider Park Ki-Byul’s sole goal is to “escape Korea.” At the depths of despair, guided by the AI Cockatoo, he encounters the mysterious group known as the “Escape Club.” Behind their sweet offer of financial support lies a strange condition. 

*“If you want to leave, change first.”*

A dangerous partnership begins with the Escape Club, which dreams not of “Escape” from the country, but of “Change” to transform the world. 

Will Ki-Byeol truly be able to break through this era of hatred and reach true happiness?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
